name: MC-Bench-VQA
description: A multiple-choice visual question answering (VQA) dataset that measures model ability to answer image-grounded questions from a set of candidate answers. It focuses on multimodal understanding and selecting the best answer among options, testing both visual recognition and commonsense/reasoning tied to images. Useful for benchmarking models on straightforward VQA multiple-choice accuracy.
reputation: A relatively small/specialized VQA benchmark with limited adoption compared to major VQA datasets; used primarily for targeted evaluations.
